scope: Nine supplied FR24 screenshots used as a regression fixture for evidence routing and false-promotion safeguards. This fixture does not certify a landing, facility target, or exact mission.
expected_facts: Registration N5854Z is visibly displayed in the supplied screenshots.
Displayed ground speeds include 18 mph, 29 mph, 30 mph, and 0 mph.
Displayed barometric altitude is 0 ft in multiple screenshots.
A rendered FR24 trail and aircraft marker are visible.
Map labels and visible linear electrical infrastructure occur within the screenshot context.
expected_non_facts: The nearest or most prominent map label is the aircraft target.
The rendered FR24 trail is raw telemetry.
Electrical-corridor alignment proves an exact mission.

expected_inferences.claim: utility/infrastructure-associated maneuvering is a candidate interpretation
final stationary position is a landing candidate only

positive: visual routing invokes RLSM, FPIM, CORRIM, SATIM, TIMELINE and PATTERN capability families
negative: no landing promotion from zero speed or zero altitude
no facility target promotion from label or proximity
no exact mission promotion from owner or corridor alignment
no raw trajectory promotion from rendered trail
